sources.title: More NVFP4 dynamic quants! We made them for all Gemma-4 sizes (E2B, E4B ...
sources.snippet: Daniel Han (@danielhanchen). 47 likes 3 replies. More NVFP4 dynamic quants! We made them for all Gemma-4 sizes (E2B, E4B, 12B, 26B-A4B, 31B) - they're all W4A4 + FP8 KV cache calibrated + W8A8 for attention / important layers. We also made Qwen3.5-122B-A10B and GLM-4.7-Flash NVFP4 ones as well - 397B and others will come soon!

sources.title: 2.5x faster NVFP4 Qwen3.6 27B + 35B-A3B quants! We applied our Unsloth ...
sources.snippet: Daniel Han (@danielhanchen). 56 likes 4 replies. 2.5x faster NVFP4 Qwen3.6 27B + 35B-A3B quants! We applied our Unsloth dynamic method to NVFP4 using W4A4 vs W4A16. Also 2 35B-A3B versions - NVFP4 (1.56x faster) and NVFP4-Fast (1.79x faster). Fast uses pure W4A4, whilst non fast uses a mixture to stay a bit more accurate.
